Optimal.Notes: A 40 Hz refresh with a matching frame cap gives the smoothest feel the Deck can reliably sustain in this game; FSR at 1024x640 recovers enough GPU headroom to keep Medium quality settings stable. Shadows are kept at Low as they are the biggest single performance cost in UE4 tactical shooters.

profiles.Summary: Ready or Not is a demanding Unreal Engine 4 tactical shooter that runs on the Steam Deck with playable performance at reduced settings, but the GPU sits between the minimum and recommended specs so low-to-medium settings with FSR are necessary for stable frame rates. The game is Steam Deck Verified with full controller support, and ProtonDB reporters trend toward platinum, suggesting it runs well under Proton without major configuration.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended specs relative to the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU (roughly GTX 1050 Ti class) and general UE4 tactical shooter behaviour. On your first run, check frame pacing in the busiest breach sequence and drop to Max Battery settings if the Optimal profile stutters.

MaxBattery.Notes: Rendering at 960x600 with FSR upscaling to 1280x800 keeps the GPU well within the TDP cap; Low settings across the board reduce CPU-side AI simulation load. Half-rate shading is left off as it causes visible shimmering in this engine.

KnownIssues: Text and UI elements can be small at 1280x800 and may require accessibility adjustments
Demanding indoor environments and large maps with many AI can cause frame rate dips below 30 fps on default settings
Online co-op may have occasional connectivity issues under Proton, though single-player and local play are generally stable
Loading times are long on slower SD cards; installing to the internal SSD is recommended

MaxPerformance.Notes: At full 15 W TDP with GPU pinned to 1600 MHz the Deck can approach 60 fps in corridors and smaller rooms, but large outdoor areas or chaotic firefights will dip to the mid-40s; the 60 fps cap is set as a ceiling rather than a guarantee. Battery drain will be significant — expect under 2 hours in sustained play.

Optimal.Notes: The 40 fps / 40 Hz lock is the sweet spot for this game on Deck — motion is smooth and the 12 W TDP keeps thermals and noise manageable across a full session. FSR upscaling from 1024x640 recovers sharpness lost from the reduced render resolution.

The game is Steam Deck Verified with full controller support, and ProtonDB reporters trend toward platinum, suggesting it runs well with minimal tweaking under Proton.

MaxBattery.Notes: Render at sub-native resolution with FSR upscaling to ease GPU load and hit the 8 W TDP target; indoor SWAT maps are relatively contained so this profile holds reasonably well. Drop to 7 W TDP if battery drain is still high.
